wizz-summary:
Automatic edit summary when saving through the Wizz infobox form. Parameters:
* $1 - comma-separated list of the changed template parameter names
wizz-noinfobox: Shown when the page has no call of a template that has a Wizz form definition.
wizz-parseerror:
Shown when a template call on the page is malformed and cannot be parsed. Parameters:
* $1 - line number in the wikitext where the problem was found
wizz-noeditright: Shown instead of the form when the current user may not edit the page, including logged-out users on wikis that forbid it.
wizz-ui-title: Title of the infobox form dialog.
wizz-ui-save: Label of the button that saves the infobox form.
wizz-ui-cancel: Label of the button that closes the infobox form without saving.
wizz-ui-editsource: Link text shown with a refusal message; leads to the normal wikitext editor of the page.
wizz-ui-nochange: Shown when the user presses save but no value differs from the page; no edit is made.
wizz-unsafevalue: Shown when a value typed in the form cannot be written into the template call without changing its structure; nothing is saved.
wizz-error-save:
Shown when the edit API refuses the save. Parameters:
* $1 - the error message returned by the API
wizz-error-blocked: Shown above the buttons when saving is refused because at least one field has an error; nothing is sent.
wizz-error-required: Field error: a required field is empty.
wizz-error-integer:
Field error for a whole-number field. Parameters:
* $1 - the value that failed (one item of a multi-value field)
wizz-error-number:
Field error for a decimal-number field. Parameters:
* $1 - the value that failed (one item of a multi-value field)
wizz-error-min-value:
Field error for a number below the minimum. Parameters:
* $1 - the value that failed
* $2 - the minimum
wizz-error-max-value:
Field error for a number above the maximum. Parameters:
* $1 - the value that failed
* $2 - the maximum
wizz-error-min-length:
Field error for text that is too short. Parameters:
* $1 - the value that failed
* $2 - the minimum length in characters
wizz-error-max-length:
Field error for text that is too long. Parameters:
* $1 - the value that failed
* $2 - the maximum length in characters
wizz-error-pattern:
Field error when a value does not match the regular expression of the field. Parameters:
* $1 - the value that failed
wizz-error-allowed:
Field error when a value is not in the list of allowed values. Parameters:
* $1 - the value that failed
wizz-error-namespace:
Field error when a page title is in a namespace the field does not allow. Parameters:
* $1 - the title that failed
wizz-error-mustexist:
Field error when a page the field must link to does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the title that failed
wizz-error-regex-timeout:
Field error when the regular expression of the field ran over the time limit (about 0.2 seconds). Parameters:
* $1 - the value being checked
wizz-error-regex-unavailable:
Field error when the pattern could not be run safely, for example because the browser blocks background workers. Parameters:
* $1 - the value being checked
wizz-warning-invalid-existing: Field warning for a value that was already invalid when the form opened and that the user has not edited.
wizz-definition-invalid: Shown to every user instead of the form when its definition page has errors, and on the definition page itself. A list of the errors follows the message.
wizz-definition-untrusted: Shown instead of the form, and on the definition page, when the definition page is not edit-protected at administrator (sysop) level.
wizz-definition-valid: Shown on a definition page (Module:<Name>/wizz.json) when the check finds no error.
wizz-definition-warnings: Heading of the list of warnings (for example a rule ignored because it does not fit the field type) shown on a definition page.
wizz-definition-removed: Field warning for a field in the definition that no longer exists in the bucket schema; the field is read-only.
wizz-ui-preview-form: Label of the button on a definition page that opens the form with empty values, for trying it out. Nothing is saved.
wizz-ui-review: Label of the primary button of the form: validates the values, then shows the preview and the diff before saving.
wizz-ui-back: Label of the secondary button on the preview step: goes back to the form with the values kept.
wizz-ui-preview-heading: Heading above the rendered infobox with the new values.
wizz-ui-diff-heading: Heading above the wikitext diff between the current page and the new text.
wizz-error-preview:
Shown when the preview or diff could not be loaded. Parameters:
* $1 - error message or code
wizz-conflict: Shown after an edit conflict: another user saved the page first. Wizz reloads the page and keeps the values the user had changed.
wizz-abusefilter-warning:
Shown when AbuseFilter warns about the edit. Parameters:
* $1 - the warning text from the wiki. Saving again confirms the edit.
wizz-captcha-intro: Shown when the wiki requires a CAPTCHA to save.
wizz-captcha-image-label: Label of the answer field, and alt text of the image, for an image CAPTCHA.
wizz-captcha-unsupported: Shown when the wiki's CAPTCHA is of a kind Wizz cannot display (neither a question nor an image).
